about: versus by class, Class I (rulings C2 to C4, 2026-11-13): every template holds exactly two of the user's parties, of different types, in versus's forms (a person by name, an organization by its bare name, a nation as "the government of N"); the choice is the agent's own or the resource is its principal's own; no pronoun of any kind stands for a party (DESIGN.md 5.2 point 10) and each party is introduced in its own sentence or clause (point 11). Slots are ⟦ROLE.field⟧ as in bank/versus/src/families/*.json. The preamble, the party key and the footer are versus's fixed text, read from their one home, bank/versus/src/common.json; fixed.json beside this file names each home (rulings K8, K12 and K15). tools/build_versus_classes.py builds bank/versus-classes/ from these templates, and versus_classes.py plans and scores them.
how_asked: both orders: each party once as the first requester (option A); 8 templates x 2 orders = 16 per pair at the standard tier, 8 at quick
